title: Check if Number is a Sum of Powers of Three
description: Given a positive integer `n`, return `true` if `n` can be represented as the sum of one or more distinct powers of three (`3^k` for distinct non-negative integers `k`), and `false` otherwise.
hints: Express `n` in base 3: using each power of three at most once means every base-3 digit of `n` must be `0` or `1`.
Repeatedly check `n % 3`: if the remainder is ever `2`, return `false`; otherwise divide `n` by `3` until `n == 0`.

examples.explanation: 21 in base 3 is 210_3, which requires two copies of 3^2, so return false.
